curatedMovie.curiosityHook: An aid worker collecting spare change wanders straight into an alien harvesting ring, forcing an underdog defense squad into high-gear combat.
curatedMovie.description: When an intergalactic fast-food chain wipes out a small New Zealand town to harvest humans, the nation's Astro-Investigation and Defense Service launches an armed rescue mission that escalates into an all-out assault.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, absurd sci-fi comedy horror with light emotional weight and energetic DIY splatter action.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Peter Jackson’s early feature mixes sci-fi splatter and slapstick comedy into a fast, irreverent siege adventure built for late-night viewing with friends.
